local_product.name: Clarity Loop AI Book Studio
local_product.mission: Turn an idea into a published book through a premium, non-technical SaaS writing environment that transforms a simple idea, title, or concept into a fully structured, publication-ready book.

design_principles: Calm, geography-first digital experiences where technology quietly guides discovery.
Respect user context, place, culture, language, and pace before optimizing for system convenience.
Use intelligent guidance to reduce cognitive load without removing meaningful user agency.
Prefer restraint, clarity, and coherence over ornamental complexity.
Keep product behavior purposeful, accessible, and aligned with the local mission.

quality_gate.behavior_change_policy: Governance documentation must not change application behavior unless an implementation task explicitly requires it.
